item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 18/Jan/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will persistently bring generally fine weather to Guangdong today and tomorrow. It will be warm during the day over the region. An intense winter monsoon is expected to start affecting southern China gradually on Tuesday. Winds will strengthen over the region. It will become cold over the coast of Guangdong in the following couple of days. Meanwhile, a broad band of clouds will cover the region. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Nokaen will linger over the seas east of the Philippines in the next couple of days.
